notes.title: Battle Commanders - Introducing Our New Game!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers, 

We proudly announce our next, currently in-development game; 

  https://pera.gs/presskit/Battle%20Commanders/images/header.png  

A battle commander simulation game where you train your fighters with a vast variety of collected skills to manage them in mythical battlegrounds.

 Core Features 

 3 on 3 online strategy simulation with bright and peppy visuals. Group up with your buddies or match with new friends for an art of war against other commanders. 
 Make a collection within thousands of unique skills to beef up your library. Hire and customize fighters to suit your personal playing style, as they level up and bring you more glories!
 You will have full control of battle strategy, decide who goes which objective and do what, also you will use ultimate skills to impact the most critical moments of fights. You are in complete control of tactics, combat positions, and objective instructions, and will be able to follow the battle live with our battle simulator.
 Experience all multiplayer online battle arena aspects in a fresh new way - high fantasy role-playing elements, classes, skills, battlegrounds, arenas, maps, lanes, objectives and tactical depth are all present. 
 Regular updates and additions of new skills, battlegrounds, classes, events and more! 


Please vote in Greenlight and share some love with your feedbacks! 

In the meantime, enjoy a weekly discount for Overfall, if you don't have it already or wish to gift a friend.

notes.title: Free Update: The Ancients Awaken!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10299072/4e1c13163c847edfc192e08385df6a99bd7c78e3.png

The aftermath of the Ancient War was devastating. The victorious Orcish Emperor executed each and everyone on Dys who practiced dark arts and summoning. The indisputable power they controlled and carried within their spirits became too dangerous to be used in the wrong hands. The bodies of those once the mightiest commanders were locked and hidden away in the Tombs that are scattered all around Dys. Never to be found again.

Until one day two heroes disembark on an island and hear the call for help of an Imperial Archaeologist.

 8 intense dungeon questlines with epic boss battles.
 More than 15 new player personas with more upgrade options.
 New and modified NPC stats and personas for more intense fights.
 Reputation questlines giving you another alternative way of finishing your playthrough.

notes.title: Overfall - Build 13/05/2016 - FINAL BUILD for Main Release!
notes.content:
Dear adventurers, 

Our final build before the main release is now open for general consumption on Steam! (note: this version will be uploaded to GOG once we’re sure there are no unexpected bugs during the transition).

Highlights for this patch includes;


All missing power SFX have been added to the game.
Added several sounds to UI elements.
Finally fixed the black screen of doom bug.
The AI will use personal all battle damaging powers correctly. In some cases this caused some AI to not move for several rounds.
Melee Charge will not protect agains rewind as it was intervening with Monk's special power. 


Thanks to everyone who contributed the Early Access to help us find the bugs and see what should be more fun in the game. Happily we have completed every missing part of the game, finished missing animations, art assets and sounds, fine tuned the game UI, balanced the battle and unlocks, added more stories to encounter, and completed our main goal for the EA - The Story Builder! 

WE DID THESE TOGETHER! 

Our aim is to be in the top ten selling titles on Steam on our launch day. That kind of visibility could make a very meaningful difference to the future of us, so we are massing all of our efforts to get there on 17 May.

You can do a lot to support our goal. If you do even one of the things below we'd be hugely grateful. 

[olist]
Tweet about the game on launch day. It takes a few seconds and will help hugely. Your endorsement of the finished product would mean a lot. 
Write a review of Overfall on Steam. Help people get to know the finished game. Upload a review after the Early Access box has left the page and help our finished game make a good impression on the public.
Facebook-post. This isn’t for everyone, but if you have friends and family who play games, or are a member of any Facebook groups who would genuinely enjoy the game, we'd love you to share it with them.
Stream the game on launch day, on Twitch, YouTube or Steam. Promote the stream to your friends and followers, we’ll feature our favourites and may even drop in. Even just playing the game on Steam on the 17th will help drive awareness!
[/olist]

notes.title: Overfall Full Release Date: May 17, 2016
notes.content:
Hello adventurers, 

We are happy to announce Overfall will be released next week, 17th of May. 

Price tag will be $14.99 USD. (Standart Valve rates for other countries)  

Early Access has been a tremendous experience for Overfall team, in which we have learned very valuable lessons, and reshaped the game according to the user feedback. Here are some noteworthy facts about the process:

We fine tuned the game UI to give more feedback and information to the player.
Important revisions are made for the unlock system; to ensure more fun, and satisfying player progression.
Lots of new visual and sounds effects are added to give the unique art style more flavor.
Apart from adding new encounters and stories, hundreds of them are also modified according to the player ratings and comments through our in-game feedback system, and online forums.
We made many tweaks and fixes on the game balance and mechanics, according to the feedback from our community and play tests.
Three different difficulty settings are introduced, ensuring the players have more freedom to play the game in their own way.
To provide infinite content, we have created and introduced the Story Builder. A tool that gives you the ability to create your own stories, and publish them via Steam Workshop.
Many improvements are made for the Story Builder, to offer the creators the best user experience possible.
Collaborating with the almighty Chris Avellone, we have created the Story Writing Guide. A guide which is not only important to define the writing pillars of Overfall, but for anyone who’s interested in game writing, and game narrative overall.
Tons of performance improvements are done to make sure as many people as possible can play Overfall, even on aged systems.


Thank you for being part of the early access experience! This community has grown beyond our expectations, and we’re both grateful and humbled by your support, ideas, critiques, and feedback since the beginning.

notes.title: Overfall - Build 11/03/2016
notes.content:
Update 2:

Monk - The Course of Nature Guild Ship Unlock fixed.
[StoryBuilder]Now we will show the previous dialog's inhabitants if the setting is set to 'DontChange'.
[StoryBuilder]Flora drop down is disabled if the encounter has a flora requirement.
[StoryBuilder]Fixing the has_key requirement check not working on story builder encounters bug.


Update 1:

Reputation progress can now also be made by attacking racial homelands and ships.
Arena Gauntlet progress is now calculated properly.
Enemy Land Invasion Quests are more rewarding now.
Crystal Archer will not attack you on the unlock quest.
Unlock requirements should check for companion personas too.
Fixing getting missed, hit, critical hit, doing critical hit, character getting pushed, character getting pulled, OnAllyDead and OnFoeDead, number of ships visited counters. Personas that require these counters should work correctly now.
Fixing a bug which in rare cases caused a choice with no ending.
End game UI will have different art if there are no unlocks.
You can skip real end game cinematic.
Fixed Goblin Cutter's Daggerfall skill animation.
Characters will now speak on the world map screen when they are low on HP to remind the player to feed them.
Characters will also talk if the Vorn start chasing.
Enemy ship chasing someone (including player) will have a red icon on their heads.
Rewards already unlocked by the player will not be rewarded at the end of the game.
After unlocking all the classes the end game reward will be something you'll be happy to see.
Everking will not be enraged. (He is a cool dude.)
Enraged characters will start to move randomly instead of doing all kinds of escape tactics.
New story arcs for some encounters.
Many other small bug fixes.

notes.title: Overfall - Build 09/03/2016
notes.content:
Damage receive animations of units improved and separated into another layer. They can now move and take damage simultaneously.
Armor Piercing, Accuracy, Defence and Critical Chance buffs of Hilt Upgrades have been boosted.
Vast majority of condition applying enchantment proc rates have been boosted.
Stats of Justicar, Gladiator, Swashbuckler, Executioner, Bloodseeker, Assassin, Shadow Adept have been modified to increase their survival.
Stats of Undead Horror, Elf Archer, Elf Trancer, Elf Silencer, Elf Vindicator, Goblin Hexxer, Goblin Blackbow, Goblin Blightmancer, Forsaken Howler, Forsaken Scryer have been modified to decrease their Speed.
Stats of Hollow Lizard and Hollow Shark have been modified to increase their Speed and HP.
Fixed "Terror and Madness" enhancement's proc rate.
The Judge's Radiance skill now should properly remove 1 debuff from allies.
Experimental persona rewards in the Arena and talking pirate corpse quest; fix for Fighter Scroll Unlock - Intimidation
The Arena is replayable via Adventure Ships.
Stuck on loading cloud because of file reading exceptions fixed.
[StoryBuilder] Encounters with errors can now be saved, but will not be loaded into the game.
[StoryBuilder] Added a new error message that checks if the first dialog is set to "Don't Change".
[StoryBuilder] Removing chance field unless the dialog has siblings.
[StoryBuilder] Node renamed to Dialog.
[StoryBuilder] Now we cannot send the Story Builder tutorial to Steam :)
[StoryBuilder] Xml exporter now uses a proper xml exporter. (Fixes save and upload problems)
[StoryBuilder] Hexes occupied by party members cannot be used for character placement in the Edit Dialog screen.
Stats in the top UI sheet will be green if higher than normal value, and red if lower.
Fixed a bug where the day count would be higher than 0 on fresh start of a playthrough.
The AI will calculate the damage it will take from tormented if it moves to a better position to attack and act accordingly.
Imported stories will now be checked for errors and removed from the game if an encounter in the file has errors. (Normally you cannot upload a story which has errors, this is for hacking attempts mostly.)
Modified the videos and video playing engine. It should be slightly better. (this is why the patch is huge)
Altar icon for resurrection tutorial .
Added back 64 bit OSX support. (It had been removed because of some bug in the engine)
The crew of a ship will never have less health than 1, no matter how severely damaged their ship.
If somehow somewhere you find a fight with negative health enemies we will fix it for you.

notes.content:

Fixed a bug where characters would spawn on click in actual playthrough after using the Story Builder.
Encounter has to have dialog inside.
Combat without enemies will now automatically end.
Story builder: selecting a character type will automatically select the first of that type.

Retaliation has a new icon.
New objects added for Story Builder.
Protection's trigger FX improved.
Charming condition has additional FX for the spell user (charmer).
UI improvement for workshop quests.
Glow FX for new unlocks when you enter character selection screen.
If we have no unlock at score screen, there is artwork for space.
Guardian weapon The Judge's Radiance is now "Any Hex" instead of "Target Enemy".
Warlord weapon Bagathur's Seismic Slam is now "Any Hex instead of "Target Enemy".
Warlord's Piercing Howl now applies Blind instead of Crippled.
Druid's Shroom Diffusion's upgrade now increases Tormented's proc rate to 50% instead of 40%.
Guardian's Renewal now also removes 1 debuff.
Guardian's Tactical Swap now applies Reduction to target if cast on an ally and now has SFX.
Guardian's Shattered Ground skill now has an 80% chance to remove 1 buff from foes.
Justicar's Safeguard, Shieldspike, Hamstring and Final Thrust skills have been tweaked.
Hunter's Flare skill now removes 1 buff instead of applying Weakness.
Fixed a problem where some of the default hero class trinkets weren't what they should be.
Following tooltips have been fixed: Monk's Tenacious Discipline, Geomancer's Earth Shock, Gravekeeper's Putrid Explosion & Jawbite.
Several missing FX and skill/animation SFX added.
Wrestler's and Assassin's missing default personas re-added.
New objects have been implemented to the game to be used in encounters.
Duration of several Personas tweaked.
Volume of several SFX altered.
Fixed several missing icons of skills and personas.
Several unlock and persona requirements have been changed to be more frequent.
Again many other small bug fixes.

 01/03/2016 Early Access Release

Story builder can now publish to Steam Workshop. You can upload a cover image, add title, description and change log.
The game will read encounters subscribed from Steam.
Now clicking on an author name during encounter will open their Steam Workshop page.
Fixed the random fatal crash on some Windows machines mostly using Radeon GPU.
Ship explosion sound FX will now respect the FX slider on the options menu.
Pirate ships should show the correct wandering around message. 
Beating the game will now reward a class unlock for sure (if there is one)
Ship tooltips now show the current health of the ship.
Story Builder UI elements will grow with the screen correctly.
Neutral characters will be saved and loaded correctly.
Added back the change display option for Windows.
Saving and returning back after resurecting a hero will not cause funny side effects any more.
Companion tooltips will give more detail of why we cannot have a companion
The upgrades will be removed for sure when opening a new game without closing the game.
Now we really restore the upgrades we did from a save game.
The battle power UI will not get stuck when hovered over during phase shifts.
Vorns will not hunt you down in packs before the citadel is revealed.
King will not get stuck searching for the citadel.
Vorns will be more careful to obey the jarls and follow them.
When the king invades the citadel player will be presented the correct final encounter.
Map generation will now create closer number of islands for each flora.
There will not be crates in front of the portal.
Update on some of the unlock encounters. Balancing them regarding user data and fixing errors.
Cannot skip movement phase by clicking the starting hex any more.
Now have a 'Skip Battle' button for Story Builder.
User stories will now be saved to Steam Cloud so you can start building at home and continue at office!
AI skipping phase due to bone pore should not skip the phase twice.
Numerous new encounters.
Lots of grammatical fixes.
Even more random bug fixes.

notes.title: Design Contest, Wiki and Early Access Price!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers,

As the days draw closer to the launch of Overfall on 1st of March, we are here to announce a Character Design Contest and seek talented contributors from all over the world to have three more characters implemented to Overfall by the winners of the contest.

Sharpen your favorite weapons and prepare to fight! Your challenge, adventurers, is to awaken that fantastic character you’ve buried deep inside your mind, make a contest entry to show everyone that character will be sailing the seas of Dys by winning this contest!

A panel of Pera Games staff members will serve as the judges of the contest and select 25 finalists. The winning entries will be announced at a date around March 15, 2016. Prize packages include not only copies of Overfall, but also drawings of the winning characters featured in quest chains in-game, and Steam Wallet Cash, coupled with numerous Kickstarter exclusive rewards!

Be sure to head on over to our contest page for further information. Best of luck to all, and may the most alluring and fascinating designs win!

OFFICIAL WIKI ANNOUNCEMENT

We’re very happy to announce a partnership with Curse/Gamepedia! Don’t lose your way in the high seas - check out the official Overfall wiki at http://overfall.gamepedia.com/

An editing contest for the wiki will be announced by the Gamepedia editors soon! We would love to see you help us on making our wiki richer by contributing on the editing process.

PRICING FOR EARLY ACCESS

Overfall will be launched at $9.99 USD during the Early Access period on Steam. For other currencies standard Valve recommended conversions will be used.

Final pricing for the full release has not been determined, but is expected to be between $9.99 and $19.99 USD.

As always you can post your thoughts, feedback, fiction and artwork on the Steam Discussion Boards. Thanks to all of you for being part of our Early Access community!
